_why: The read-path bench's questions about this repository (D278): `present` asks how something works now, answered by a rule in an area document; `history` asks what happened or why, answered by the archive, the fix log or a decision, `by` an identifier as builders look it up or by its words. Each `answer` lists the files that count as right. Read by tools/read-path-bench.mjs and by the service's PresentFirstBenchTests.

present.question: what does the comment gate refuse
what does daoris check fail on
where is a fresh tree's worktree made and on which branch
which bridge modules does the page reach the machine through
what makes a folder an install
what happens to a plugin whose apiVersion is newer
which workflow does a chain's work follow
what does a channel message's level decide
which agents are built in and how does each connect
which door changes a session's roles
how often does a knowledge server over one checkout read it again
what does a conversation do at its account's limit

history.question: why is the archive kept in one file rather than split by month
when did every start inherit DAORIS_HOST_TOKEN
why does a budget report and never fail
when was the old workflow logic retired
root cause of every account signed out after the application started
why is each thing done one way only
